title: What's new: Demystifying the New Microsoft Copilot Chat in Business Central
summary: This session explains how the new Microsoft Copilot chat in Business Central works behind the scenes. It opens with a live demo where Copilot answers an item price question using Business Central data and web exchange rates, then resolves a vague "S100" request. The second half walks through the flow of a request: conversation, page context, intent detection and an agentic loop over several tools. It closes with answers to common questions about permissions, admin control, the Business Central MCP server, citations for checking accuracy, and how to send feedback.

chapters.title: Introduction and goal of the session
Demo: top items in Danish crone and vague S100 query
How Copilot chat works: context, intent, agentic loop, response
Q&A: data access via MCP server and ISV guidance
Q&A: trusting answers with citations and sources

features.name: Microsoft Copilot chat in Business Central
features.description: A Copilot chat pane next to the Business Central page that reasons over your data and answers questions in a conversation. It shows progress messages, tables and citations.
features.status_evidence_quote: the new Microsoft copilot chat to come to all our users with this release

features.name: Answers combining Business Central data and web data
features.description: Copilot looked up items sorted by unit price, pulled the USD to Danish crone rate from a web source, and calculated the converted price in a table with clickable citations.

features.name: Resolving vague item references
features.description: A short vague query like "tell me about S100" was resolved by Business Central tools to the matching item without typing the full name. The answer showed units, basic details and citations.

features.name: Page context and user knowledge sent to Copilot
features.description: Copilot can pull content from the page you are on, including pages of installed extensions, plus knowledge about you such as your role. This is sent along with the conversation as a hint for the answer.

features.name: Intent detection and agentic loop
features.description: Copilot first detects intent from the message history, then iterates through multiple tools instead of a one-time attempt. Tools include Business Central tools, work data such as calendar, Outlook and SharePoint, other agents, and the web.
caveats: Described as different from the earlier chat integration, which made a one-time attempt

features.name: Grounded rich responses with suggestions
features.description: Responses are grounded so the user can check where data comes from, and can include charts and tables. Copilot also returns suggested follow-up questions so the chat continues as a real conversation.

features.name: Copilot respects user permissions
features.description: Copilot runs as the signed-in user, so any Business Central tables or data are accessed only within that user's permissions. A user without permission to salary data cannot get an answer about it.

features.name: Admin control of Copilot access
features.description: A Copilot and agent capabilities page lets admins opt in or out of AI features and control who or what Copilot capabilities are enabled. Admins should agree to the terms.
caveats: Shown on a slide, not demoed live
prerequisites: Admins must agree to the AI feature terms

features.name: Business Central MCP server as data access layer
features.description: Copilot retrieves Business Central data through the same MCP server used for all agentic integration. It can reach all tables, including installed extensions and customizations, without custom APIs.
caveats: Details are in separate MCP sessions and at aka.ms/bcmcp

features.name: ISV guidance for Copilot-friendly extensions
features.description: A Microsoft Learn article gives guidelines for building extensions so Copilot and agents can work with them more easily, for example by making them more descriptive.
caveats: Only referenced, content not covered in the video

features.name: Citations, progress messages and sources button
features.description: Answers include clickable citation pills that open the content in the Business Central pane, progress messages, and a sources button listing everything the AI saw and cited. Users can use these to check accuracy.

features.name: Feedback on Copilot responses
features.description: Users can give a thumbs up and share extra content such as screenshots and prompts, to help the product group troubleshoot and learn from unexpected results.
